scientific_integrity: Four-height exact algebraic proof supplemented by an independently replayable rational-symbolic checker. Finite checks are not a substitute for the Descartes and sign-bracket proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Four exact positive smoothing heights and counts; not a complete all-height phase diagram, sharp central-weight range, or minimal sample-size result. Literature priority is provisional. Distinct-data robustness is existential rather than quantitatively optimized.
title: A positive Cauchy scale-space counterexample with reentrant trimodality
